layout_and_spacing.bento_grid: MODE A: TETRIS GRID (col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2, col-span-4, etc.)
layout_and_spacing.padding_rules: All containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to avoid text collision.

component_guidelines.header: Sticky glassmorphism header with backdrop-blur-md bg-sand/80 z-50
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with flame-orange primary fill and deep-green accent hover states
component_guidelines.cards: Subtle border with 1px stroke (border-ink/10), p-6 padding, hover translate animation
component_guidelines.interactivity: Include data-testid on all interactive controls (buttons, navigation links, filters)

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for headers without blur
Use 2-3x generous padding and clean contrast
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes
Use live verified Unsplash URLs for internship page photos
Maintain the orange (#E8490F) + green (#166534) + sand (#FAF8F5) editorial palette
